buzzing.title: Dust
buzzing.overview: Sam’s questions about mortality and death are ignited when he comes across a deer carcass on a family backpacking trip. These questions become more pertinent when Sam’s dad receives a phone call about a death in the family, which he withholds from telling the kids as he sits with his own grief. Sam’s observation of the natural elements, his relationship with his siblings, and his own introspection culminate around the campfire on the last night of the trip, when Dad breaks the news of their Grandma’s death.

buzzing.title: Grandmasters
buzzing.overview: The once esoteric and uninspired world of competitive chess is thrown into turmoil when an eccentric German entrepreneur enlists reigning champion Magnus Carlsen to launch a new league that aims to revolutionize the game, challenge the sport's governing body, and "make chess cool."

buzzing.title: California Schemin'
buzzing.overview: In the late 1990s, Gavin Bain and Billy Boyd had their musical ambitions consistently ridiculed for having the 'wrong' accents, so they went for broke and reinvented themselves as Californian rappers. The duo re-recorded their own tracks with fake accents and turned up in London claiming to be an established duo on the Cali scene as well as childhood friends with Eminem. They quickly bagged themselves a record deal, a hefty sum in advances, and an appearance on MTV... until it all came crashing down.

buzzing.title: The Last First: Winter K2

buzzing.title: Monster: The Ed Gein Story
